Spidy Prep - open-source credits
================================

The lessons, problems, MCQs, interview questions, Verilog simulator, circuit lab
and site code are original to this project.

Bundled third-party software (both MIT licensed, licence files included):

- xcc C compiler by tyfkda, packaged as WebAssembly by Romain Casati
  (@basthon/xcc-wasm 0.1.0) - assets/vendor/xcc/
- CodeMirror 5.65.18 by Marijn Haverbeke and others - assets/vendor/codemirror/

Fonts: Space Grotesk, Inter and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts (SIL Open Font License).
